As stated the scope is vacuous/miscategorized: a formally new barrier over a possibly empty or incoherent class, with area hypothesis supplying its own bundle identification. This is exactly vacuity/type-confusion that STANDARD and TARGET policy exclude from value even if literally true. Hence value FAILS; no bounded addition short of rebuilding the Poisson model and exhibiting the object could rescue it.
